API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingIpv6 Config Resource Get DNS64 Prefixes
Ipv6 Config Resource Get DNS64 Prefixes
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ipv6config/dns64prefix

Gets the list of NAT64 prefixes configured as the DNS64 prefix for the organization. To learn more, see About the DNS64 Prefix

.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to match against a DNS64 prefix’s name, description, or prefixMask attributes.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

A unique identifier for the NAT64 prefix.

name
string

The name of the NAT64 prefix.

description
string

The description of the NAT64 prefix.

prefixMask
string

The subnet mask for the NAT64 prefix.

dnsPrefix
boolean

Indicates whether or not this NAT64 prefix is the DNS64 prefix.

nonEditable
boolean

Indicates whether or not this NAT64 prefix is editable.

]
